questions.subject: Basic Technology
questions.question: State three important workshop safety rules.
questions.answer: Wear appropriate personal protective equipment, keep the work area clean, and use tools correctly according to their intended purpose.

questions.subject: Basic Graphics Technology
questions.question: Name two instruments used for accurate technical drawing.
questions.answer: A drawing board and a set square are examples of technical drawing instruments.

questions.subject: Basic Technology
questions.question: Give two properties that should be considered when selecting a material for a product.
questions.answer: Examples include strength, durability, hardness, flexibility, weight and resistance to corrosion.

questions.subject: Basic Graphics Technology
questions.question: What is the purpose of a drawing scale?
questions.answer: A scale allows an object to be represented proportionally at a size different from its actual size.

questions.subject: Technical Drawing
questions.question: What are the three principal views commonly used to describe a three-dimensional object?
questions.answer: Front view, top view and right-side view are commonly used principal views.

questions.subject: Applied Technology
questions.question: Why should a workpiece be securely held before a cutting operation?
questions.answer: Secure holding prevents movement, improves accuracy and reduces the risk of injury.

questions.subject: Technical Drawing
questions.question: An object has width 60 mm, height 40 mm and depth 60 mm. What are the overall dimensions of the front, top and right-side views?
questions.answer: Front: 60 × 40 mm. Top: 60 × 60 mm. Right-side: 60 × 40 mm.

questions.subject: Applied Technology
questions.question: List four stages that may be included in a technology design process.
questions.answer: Identify the problem, investigate and generate ideas, develop and test a solution, and evaluate the final product.

questions.subject: Technical Drawing
questions.question: Why are sectional views used in technical drawing?
questions.answer: They reveal internal features that may not be clearly visible in an external view.

questions.subject: Applied Technology
questions.question: Name three criteria that can be used to evaluate a designed product.
questions.answer: Function, safety, durability, cost, appearance, environmental impact and suitability are possible criteria.
